reason: I do not know these partners and there are no reviews or Google photos for them yet, and I will not pay SAR 1,300 or more for a service I cannot check first. The idea of holding my money until the work is done helps, but it does not tell me who the installer is.
objection: Who are these installers, and where are their real reviews and past work? With the first partners only being added now in Riyadh and Cairo, I have nothing to judge them by.
would_change_my_mind: Verified Google reviews and photos of finished BMW M4 jobs from partners in my own city, which I can check myself before I quote or pay.
